h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Farrukhabad

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Farrukhabad

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Farrukhabad

c: Schools and colleges make up a large share of outdoor gym enquiries from district towns like Farrukhabad, on the banks of the Ganga. A school ground used for physical education needs machines that young people find worth using and that stand up to rough handling. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, municipal parks and housing colonies in Farrukhabad, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away.

We send the machines by road and install them through our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted into the ground or on a self-standing base. Before anything is made, you get a layout drawing showing where each station goes and the clear space it needs. That helps a principal or management committee check the plan against the playground, the assembly area and the sports pitch.

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Is outdoor gym equipment suitable for school students?
items.a: Yes, for older students under supervision. Bodyweight frames such as parallel bars and pull up stations suit physical education periods. Younger children should use playground equipment instead, since the machines are sized for teenagers and adults.

items.q: Where should the gym go on a school ground?
items.a: Away from ball games and the main assembly area, on firm and level ground with a clear zone around each machine. We mark these zones on the layout drawing.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Farrukhabad?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road and install the equipment with our team or a dealer in north India. Installation can be planned for a holiday or a weekend so classes are not disturbed.
